s: A technical showcase — every pixel, light beam, and sound cue speaks.
d: For this one, the mission was to go above and beyond. Using 3DS Max, V-Ray, PhoenixFD for smoke dynamics, and After Effects for post-rendering. Compiled in Premiere Pro where the SFX magic was done.

s: A visually stunning Pulsar instrument in action.
d: A project I am most proud of. A blend of 3D modeling, look-dev, technical accuracy, particle simulation, precise camera movements, motion graphics, sound design, and many hours of rendering.

s: Dynamic logo animation synced to Mincer's own music.
d: Crafted in 3DS Max with PhoenixFD for smoke animation, and After Effects with the Maxon Red Giant plugin. All synced to Mincer's very own music.

s: A dynamic, technical, and rich in VFX and SFX revealer that introduces a cutting-edge high-density instrument for volume AI Rack testing.
d: Using 3DS Max, V-Ray, and TyFlow for Particle Physics. Post editing done in After Effects.

s: Highly technical teaser for a revolutionary product
d: This short - and highly technical - teaser presents dynamic camera motions and effects made inside 3DS Max using TyFlow for the particle physics used for lightning and PhoenixFD for the clouds and smoke simulation. A fitting soundtrack was curated to fully convey the vibe of the video, while injecting key SFX elements to sell the ambience.

t: Christmas at MultiLane — A Snow Globe
s: The MultiLane Campus reimagined in 3D as a snow globe.
d: A reproduction of the MultiLane Campus in 3D — made in 3DS Max using V-Ray and SnowPlus. A very special snow globe.
